item.title: github: Dependabot alerts REST API now includes dependency versions
item.description:
Dependabot alerts REST API responses now include the vulnerable dependency’s version directly. A new version_requirement field has been added to each alert’s dependency object.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Usage metrics API adds pull request review stages
item.description:
GitHub’s enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics reports now include pull request review stage timing. Each repos-1-day row gets a new pull_request_review_times array with time spent in each review stage.

  • Source: GitHub
